name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A small floating label that appears next to a button as the cursor hovers it, then fades away.
useWhen: Showing a hover tooltip appearing next to a UI element in a product walkthrough.
Demonstrating a contextual label that explains an icon or action.
Sequencing a show, read, hide moment: side sets the axis the tooltip enters from.
avoidWhen: You need a title and description in the overlay: use popover.
You need a persistent side panel with actions: use sheet.
You need a blocking confirmation: use alert-dialog.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Side
variables.description: Which side of the button the tooltip sits on, and the axis it enters from.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
